decisions.reason: Transactional email is featured on the home page and extends the core messaging business in a growing market, so it likely meets aspirations and needs no problemistic search.
Managed capture has its own page and documented customer adoption, signalling performance at or above aspiration in a growing digitalisation market.

Email-to-fax conversion fits the firm's established fax and email infrastructure at low marginal cost, and slack from a hiring, growing firm lets it carry the product despite the long-term fax decline.
The fax delivery optimisation feature is embedded in the core fax service and serves regulated customers, so dropping it would release few resources even though fax is declining.
Sandbox threat protection addresses rising security demand and probably absorbed resources freed when the multi-engine virus scanning product was dropped, so it is likely performing above aspiration.
